text_block_list.text:
Passing by the outdoor stage after school, 
I heard a clear, resonant singing voice.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: —The dream carries on~♪

I couldn't help but applaud the resonance 
of her earnest voice. It wasn't just 
gentle; there was something in her singing 
that set my heart ablaze.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Huh... Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Um? B-But why are you clapping――
choice_data_list:
Because I thought your dedication was 
admirable.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Oh my... I feel a bit embarrassed, even 
though it was only a rehearsal.
choice_data_list: What do you mean by rehearsal?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Well, a lot of girls in my class feel like 
the 'main character' type, but—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Take Pokke-chan, for example. She's been 
strong ever since her freestyle racing 
days, and so many Umamusume look up to 
her.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Tachyon-chan has this grand dream... She 
wants to elevate the potential of all 
Umamusume, not just her own.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Cafe-chan is quiet on the outside, but 
underneath she hides a burning passion, 
always training late into the night...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Unlike me, everyone else is shining so 
brightly――

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Still, that's exactly why I don't want to 
forget that feeling of 'I can do it too.'

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I want to sing there too one day... Right 
where only the "main star" gets to stand.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: That's why—this is a "dress rehearsal."

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Even if I'm not strong enough yet, as long 
as I don't give up, I can challenge it as 
many times as it takes.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Because that's the whole reason I came to 
Tracen Academy!

I was deeply moved by the hidden passion 
beneath Dantsu Flame's seemingly meek 
exterior. She isn't just good-natured; she 
possesses genuine strength.
choice_data_list: I'd love to hear one more song!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! If there's anything weird, explain 
it to me, okay?!

For a while after that, I simply enjoyed 
listening to Dantsu Flame's lively 
singing.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Right after this, it's time for training! 
Dreams won't come true just by 
daydreaming!

Saying that, Dantsu Flame dashed off, and 
I watched her go with supportive thoughts.
